-OWd2l92lWbXzje8a3uQ.Text: This moment matters. So do you.

-OWd2l92lWbXzje8a3uR.Text: Let faith arise, even in the smallest spark.

-OWd2l92lWbXzje8a3uS.Text: You belong here—just as you are.
